sourcePlan.contributionSummary: Fixes atomic bulk review persistence and bounded medal grants; adds guarded event-1011-only recovery and a reusable main-based hotfix release lane. No live recovery or production operation has run.

publicNote.description: Staff can finish large event reviews without attendance saves timing out, and bulk medal grants report unfinished work safely. A temporary staff-only command can restore the IAE event review without awarding merits, while isolated hotfix releases keep unrelated changes out of production.
